label: CO Sales Channel
description: Set by the Order Import Service for channel orders (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §8). Empty for manual local orders.
name: Sales Order-co_sales_channel

label: CO Channel Order ID
description: External order ID exactly as the channel provides it. Unique together with CO Sales Channel — enforced by the Order Import Service and tests (INV-11A).
name: Sales Order-co_channel_order_id

label: CO Fulfillment Type
description: SELF, FBA, or WFS only — UNKNOWN is classifier-internal and blocks import (INV-6). Imports never leave this blank; blank is permitted only on manual non-channel orders.
name: Sales Order-co_fulfillment_type
